Tonight we host Sandbach United at the Balufab Stadium 

Adults £5 
Concession £3 
U16 £1 

Can we top last week with our attendance 👏🏽

 half an hour until kick off.

Kick off 0’

🔴⚪️0-0🟡🟡

🔴⚪️ v 🟡🟡

Market Drayton v Sandbach United

Game underway here at the home of the Ginger Bread men, on a firm pitch but with a reasonable sprinkling of grass, an important night for The Bach as the seek an away win in Shropshire

0 0

🔴⚪️ v 🟡🟡

Market Drayton v Sandbach United

And it’s 1 0 to Market Drayton as they finish with a pile driver from 20yards, Hall with no chance

1 0

7 mins gone

7’ GOAL AIDAN MCCANN

A lovely left footed strike from outside the box gives Drayton the lead 

🔴⚪️1-0🟡🟡 https://t.co/XUvOqKiT0P

🔴⚪️ v 🟡🟡

Market Drayton v Sandbach United

And it’s quickly 1 1 as Robbie the Hitman Hatton lurks at the back post and buries his header from a delicious Cope corner

1 1

10 mins gone

10’ GOAL SANDBACH

Corner for Sandbach and headed home by Robbie Hatton 

🔴⚪️1-1🟡🟡
Superb header from a deep corner. Well done Robbie. https://t.co/9WtcmICjmO

14’ Corner for Sandbach taken by Nolan headed out, Drayton go on the counter but Oakley can’t quite find Wood and it goes through to the keeper 

🔴⚪️1-1🟡🟡

16’ Wood puts in McIntosh who knocks it to the right of the defender and just puts wide of the right post 

🔴⚪️1-1🟡🟡

🔴⚪️ v 🟡🟡

Market Drayton v Sandbach United

Let off for The Bach as the MD 9 glides past the Bach defence, but places his shot wide of the far post

1 1

17 mins gone

17’ Sandbach winger puts in a dangerous ball but it’s well defended by Sutton 

🔴⚪️1-1🟡🟡

19’ Corner for Sandbach taken by Nolan, cleared by Drayton falls to A yellow on the edge who smashes it over 

🔴⚪️1-1🟡🟡

🔴⚪️ v 🟡🟡

Market Drayton v Sandbach United

It’s 2 1 to The Bach as the Sandbach 11 does the right back, his cross is smacked against the post by Kieran Nolan and as the ball is recycled Kieron O’Connell is on hand to finish at the back post, get in!

1 2

21 mins gone

21’ GOAL SANDBACH 

OCONNELL

All comes from a dubious offside given against Drayton. Sandbach move the ball quickly, they hit the post and are quickest to react. OConnell puts it in 

🔴⚪️1-2🟡🟡

🔴⚪️ v 🟡🟡

Market Drayton v Sandbach United 

And now it’s MD turn to equalise as a slick move down their right is slid in at the back post by the MD 9. All level again……

2 2

25 mins gone

26’ GOAL DRAYTON 

ITS Cian McIntosh 

Tom Horton drives into the box, squares it for Cian to tap in 

What a game 

🔴⚪️2-2🟡🟡 https://t.co/PCXZ3Hqln3

42’ GOAL SANDBACH 

corner whipped in and Nathan Barry heads home 

🔴⚪️2-3🟡🟡

🔴⚪️ v 🟡🟡

Market Drayton v Sandbach United 

And the Bach make it 3 with another header from a corner as Nathan Barry buries it, great finish and well deserved from the hard working Bach 9

2 3

42 mins gone
45’ Drags gets dragged down in the box. Ref gives a Freekick on the edge of the box 🤯

🔴⚪️ v 🟡🟡

Market Drayton v Sandbach United 

And its level again as MD bury a free kick from just outside the area, great goal tbf

3 3

45 mins gone

GOOOOOOOOOOAL

WHO CARES BECAUSE CIAN MCINTOSH SLOTS HOME THE FREE KICK 

GET INNNNNN

🔴⚪️3-3🟡🟡

Yes you read that right 6 goals in the first half https://t.co/qDxnUbK76h

What a half 6 goal thriller all for a fiver 

Market Drayton Town 3-3 Sandbach United

Goals For Drayton 
McCann
McIntosh Brace https://t.co/fn49vt6G5p

Second half gets under way. 

Will it be another rollercoaster of a half 
Strap in..here we go 

🔴⚪️3-3🟡🟡

Market Drayton v Sandbach United 

2nd half underway

3 3

47’ massive chance for Sandbach, Hatton lifts it over the bar from 6 yards out 

🔴⚪️3-3🟡🟡

Market Drayton v Sandbach United 

Greg Hall saves well with his feet as Armando Wood works himself some space in the box

3 3

59 mins gone

58’ Wood beats the sandbach full back cuts back onto his right and the keeper saves with his feet 

59’ Woodroffe whips a dangerous ball in and its headed over by McIntosh

Two good chances for Drayton 

🔴⚪️3-3🟡🟡

64’ Army breaks free takes on 3 players… squares it to McIntosh who can’t steer it home 

🔴⚪️3-3🟡🟡
